entities.name: Zivan
entities.description: Renowned Azorius Arbiter and legislator who fell from grace and was murdered.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Governing body of the Azorius guild, which Zivan served.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: Guild whose pleasure houses led to Zivan's fall.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: Guild subjected to a mass arrest.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: High-ranking judge who ordered the mass arrest of Golgari.

entities.name: Relov
entities.description: Arbiter who signed the mass arrest order and became the next murder target.

entities.name: Javy
entities.description: Old friend of Relov, allied with Vraska, who sought a reckoning; likely killed Zivan.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Gorgon allied with Javy; planeswalker whose orders likely led to Zivan's death.

entities.name: Mass arrest of Golgari
entities.description: Arrest signed by Zivan that caused many deaths and set off retribution.

events.summary: Zivan spoke for sixteen hours straight to filibuster a request for refugee assistance.
events.quote: Zivan once spoke for sixteen hours straight to filibuster a request for refugee assistance

events.summary: Zivan fell from grace indulging in the pleasure houses of the Cult of Rakdos.
events.quote: he fell from grace, indulging in the pleasure houses offered by the Cult of Rakdos

events.summary: Zivan signed the mass arrest of Golgari ordered by Isperia, leading to many deaths.
events.quote: He signed the mass arrest of Golgari ordered by Isperia

events.summary: Years later Zivan was found dead, bled out from words carved by magic on his body.
events.quote: he was found dead, bled out from the words of Azorius statues magically carved all over his body

events.summary: Relov, who had signed the arrest order, became the next target.
events.quote: Arbiter Relov , who had signed the mass arrest order without understanding its full implications, became the next target

relations.note: He was an Arbiter and legislator there.
relations.quote: Zivan was once a renowned Arbiter and legislator within the Azorius Senate
It was likely Javy on the orders of Vraska who was responsible for Zivan's death.
His old friend Javy , now allied with a gorgon named Vraska
